name: distributed
cmd: nproc; bun research/protocols/enum/probe.ts distributed_lock --held --depth 200 --trials 300 --check houdini --trace --ms 1500000 --show 0 --out /tmp/out.json; s=$?; cat /tmp/out.json; times; exit $s

name: sharded
